summary: Prepare trusted parsers for native container build stages and Linux ARM targets
details: Recognize explicit native BUILDPLATFORM stages, local stage aliases and the empty scratch base without treating them as external image dependencies; unknown platform variables, flags and image variables still fail closed.

Allow the support schema to parse explicit Linux arm64 runtime/server selections and preserve immutable Go/Alpine pin checks with native stage selectors. The selected support policy and current image workflow remain unchanged.

compatibility.notes: This preparatory parser delivery changes neither the selected runtime matrix nor Dockerfile/publisher behavior; runtime qualification and image publication remain separate EVY-1405 work.

security: Keep exact pinned-base checks, explicit platform syntax, bounded parsing, declared dependency discovery and rejection of unresolved image inputs. Adopt parser capability through the normal required checks before proposing inputs that need it.
limitations: Recognizing a platform or empty base is not native runtime qualification, registry verification or permission to publish.
The current source inventory still observes declared base images on its documented Linux amd64 scanner platform; final runtime image evidence is separate.
